nbd392133ab.headline: India, NZ to bolster ties and revive free trade talks
nbd392133ab.summary: India and New Zealand will deepen their defence and economic ties and revisit negotiations to strike a free trade agreement.
nbd392133ab.why: Free trade agreements reduce tariffs and shape market access between countries. Bilateral trade deals influence exporters and investment flows.

nb2b72f74e6.headline: This is why property taxes are spiking — NJ Top News
nb2b72f74e6.summary: Lawmakers made it easier for New Jersey towns to impose sharp property tax increases for 2025, and several towns are seeing large increases.
nb2b72f74e6.why: Property tax levels affect local government finances, municipal bond credit and residential real estate values. Policy changes in individual states shape these dynamics.

nfd0fc47e08.headline: Airline executives hit turbulence at parliamentary inquiry
nfd0fc47e08.summary: The ACCC says Australia's four biggest airports made a combined one billion dollar operating profit, helped by car parking and airline fees, while passenger numbers remain below pre-pandemic levels.
nfd0fc47e08.why: Airport charges and airline fees shape aviation costs and profitability in Australia. The ACCC is the Australian Competition and Consumer Commission, the country's competition and consumer regulator.

nc29d525ab6.headline: IMF has received a formal request for a new Kenya financing programme
nc29d525ab6.summary: The International Monetary Fund has received a formal request for a new programme from Kenyan authorities and will engage with them going forward. The IMF made the statement on Monday.
nc29d525ab6.why: The IMF provides financing and policy support to member countries facing balance-of-payments needs. A new programme for Kenya would affect its fiscal path and access to external funding.

n02bfd78088.headline: Understanding VAT in South Africa
n02bfd78088.summary: South Africa announced a VAT increase in its recent Budget Speech. An explainer outlines what Value Added Tax is and why it matters.
n02bfd78088.why: VAT is a consumption tax applied across goods and services, so rate changes feed directly into consumer prices and government revenue. South Africa's Budget sets the fiscal path for Africa's most industrialised economy.

n71459ea197.headline: IndusInd Bank shares rise post RBI assurance; time to add or avoid? - BusinessToday
n71459ea197.summary: IndusInd Bank shares rose 0.72 per cent to settle at Rs 676.95, after the stock had fallen 35.40 per cent over the past month.
n71459ea197.why: IndusInd Bank is a large private-sector lender in India, and Reserve Bank of India statements shape sentiment across the country's banking shares.

n7bf80e6525.headline: Gold price can keep rising, says UBS
n7bf80e6525.summary: Gold set a new record above $3,000 per ounce at the end of last week and was trading sideways just under $2,900. UBS said the price can keep rising.
n7bf80e6525.why: Gold is a traditional store of value and a hedge against inflation and currency risk. Its price is widely tracked by investors as a macro and risk-sentiment indicator.

impacts.name: Gold
impacts.why: The forecast concerns the gold price, which recently hit a record high above $3,000 per ounce.

nea9c1891b5.headline: Number of buy-to-let companies soars in the wake of mortgage interest relief changes
nea9c1891b5.summary: The number of UK buy-to-let companies reached a record 401,744, up 332% since 2016, according to Hamptons. The rise follows changes to mortgage interest relief.
nea9c1891b5.why: Buy-to-let is a major segment of the UK private rental market. Tax and financing rules for landlords affect property investment, mortgage lending and rental supply.

ne8f22e3898.headline: Shoppers and treasurer try to stretch budget dollar
ne8f22e3898.summary: The treasurer has acknowledged checkout price pain as he prepares the federal budget. Research shows grocery prices weighing on shoppers' budgets.
ne8f22e3898.why: Grocery inflation shapes household spending and the policy choices made in the federal budget, which matters for Australian rates and growth expectations.

n4b0d0d8943.headline: Argentina's GDP seen growing in Q4 after shrinking for six quarters
n4b0d0d8943.summary: Argentina's economy is expected to have grown year-on-year in the fourth quarter of 2024. That would end six consecutive quarters of year-on-year contraction.
n4b0d0d8943.why: GDP growth data signals the health of Argentina's economy, influencing investor views on its assets, sovereign debt and currency.

ncd8d4d4a64.headline: Burnham Rails Against Planned Starmer Welfare Cuts in Labour Rebellion
ncd8d4d4a64.summary: Labour is reportedly set to drop a proposed freeze on rising Personal Independence Payments after a large backlash. Andy Burnham has criticised the planned welfare cuts.
ncd8d4d4a64.why: Welfare spending decisions shape UK public finances and fiscal policy, which matter to gilt markets and the government's budget outlook.

nc0621fe454.headline: Cyclone's blow to budget as food, building costs hit
nc0621fe454.summary: The full impact of Cyclone Alfred is being assessed, with grocery and construction prices rising. The cyclone's damage is affecting the budget outlook.
nc0621fe454.why: Natural disasters can raise food and construction costs and strain public budgets, affecting inflation and government spending in affected regions. Australia's budget is set by the federal government.

n5344a1d485.headline: What to know in the final days of store closures for Party City, Joann and more
n5344a1d485.summary: Several major US retailers are holding large sales as they prepare to close all or many of their stores. The article outlines what shoppers should know during the final days.
n5344a1d485.why: Party City and Joann are US specialty retailers; store closures reflect pressure on brick-and-mortar retail. Liquidation activity affects landlords, suppliers and retail sector sentiment.

n9226d36fb4.headline: Govt prepares various policies to spur economic growth ahead of Eid
n9226d36fb4.summary: The government has prepared various policies ahead of Eid al-Fitr 2025 to encourage national economic growth. Officials are encouraging economic activity during the holiday period.
n9226d36fb4.why: Government stimulus and policy measures around major holidays can influence consumer spending and growth in the economy. Indonesia is Southeast Asia's largest economy.

n0edd92fb83.headline: GCC Expats Sent Less Money Home - What’s Behind the Decline?
n0edd92fb83.summary: A GCC-Stat report shows total remittances from workers in the Gulf Cooperation Council declined. The report is cited in Arab Times coverage from Muscat.
n0edd92fb83.why: Remittances from migrant workers are a significant source of income for many developing economies and a flow tracked by Gulf policymakers.

ncc51b69f45.headline: OECD Downgrades UK Growth Projection in Blow to Reeves
ncc51b69f45.summary: The OECD published its latest interim economic outlook for G20 economies and downgraded its UK growth projection. The report includes meaningful reductions in growth forecasts.
ncc51b69f45.why: The OECD is the Paris-based forecaster for advanced economies, and its growth projections shape views on UK fiscal policy and gilt yields.

n1f2736f2ed.headline: Carney’s move to kill carbon price now official but debate over it not dead
n1f2736f2ed.summary: Prime Minister Mark Carney's move on Friday to end the consumer carbon price has become official. The move has done little to end the long-running political battle over the policy.
n1f2736f2ed.why: The consumer carbon price is a federal levy that affects fuel costs, energy policy and climate-related compliance for businesses in Canada.

nf8c2d6cad7.headline: India Stands To Gain In An Increasingly Uncertain World Of Tariffs: SBI Report » IndiaPost NewsPaper
nf8c2d6cad7.summary: An SBI report says Trump's planned reciprocal tariffs may lead to a 3-3.5% decline in Indian exports, and India could gain from an uncertain tariff environment.
nf8c2d6cad7.why: Exports to the US are a significant share of India's trade, so tariff changes affect export-oriented sectors and the rupee.

n409667f23e.headline: Trump says there will be no exemptions from steel and aluminum tariffs
n409667f23e.summary: President Trump said there will be no exemptions from steel and aluminum tariffs, which take effect April 2. The move has raised fears of a global trade war.
n409667f23e.why: Steel and aluminum tariffs raise input costs for manufacturers and can trigger retaliatory trade measures between major economies.
n409667f23e.why_moved: The announcement of no tariff exemptions, effective April 2, raised fears of a global trade war, according to the input.

n0e70a0f2ca.headline: Doubling housing supply incentive could help renters
n0e70a0f2ca.summary: Australia is expected to fall hundreds of thousands of homes short of its housing target. Reforms, including a doubling housing supply incentive, could help renters.
n0e70a0f2ca.why: Housing supply shapes rents, construction activity and household finances, and is a key policy lever for the Australian economy.

nba8c38d531.headline: Swiss National Bank seen cutting rates 25 bps, risk of negative rates low
nba8c38d531.summary: Most economists polled expect the Swiss National Bank to cut its policy rate by 25 basis points on March 20 to 0.25%. They see the risk of negative rates as low.
nba8c38d531.why: The Swiss National Bank sets monetary policy for Switzerland, and its rate decisions influence the Swiss franc and global safe-haven flows.

n161a759f0e.headline: Car prices to go up: Maruti Suzuki plans 4% hike from April 2025 - BusinessToday
n161a759f0e.summary: Maruti Suzuki plans to raise car prices again by 4% from April 2025 as input costs soar.
n161a759f0e.why: Maruti Suzuki is India's largest carmaker by volume, so its pricing decisions signal cost pressures across the auto sector.

n0a9668ce24.headline: China, Russia, Iran Call for End of Sanctions, Restart of Nuclear Talks
n0a9668ce24.summary: At a meeting in Beijing, China, Russia and Iran called for an end to sanctions and a restart of nuclear talks, a move one analyst said challenges US Middle East policy.
n0a9668ce24.why: Sanctions on Iran and nuclear negotiations affect global oil supply expectations and the geopolitical risk premium in energy markets.

nafc7312e99.headline: Gemini AI Found Removing Watermarks, Including Getty Images
nafc7312e99.summary: Social media users reported that Gemini 2.0 can remove watermarks from images, including Getty Images, triggering copyright concerns.
nafc7312e99.why: Alphabet's Google develops Gemini, and Getty Images licenses a large library of photos whose watermarks signal copyright ownership.

n4acd8fb324.headline: BYD claims new EV charging tech almost as fast as filling up with petrol, diesel
n4acd8fb324.summary: BYD has claimed new electric vehicle charging technology that is almost as fast as filling a petrol or diesel tank, alongside a platform adding 400km of range.
n4acd8fb324.why: BYD is one of the world's largest electric vehicle makers, and charging speed is a key factor in EV adoption and competition.

impacts.name: BYD
impacts.why: The company announced new charging and platform technology for its vehicles.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

n10c2c6832c.headline: German industry cries out: slash red tape to revive economy
n10c2c6832c.summary: Ten executives and business association heads say Germany's new leadership must sharply reduce bureaucracy alongside plans to boost public investment. Industries from cars to energy and shipping are represented.
n10c2c6832c.why: Germany is Europe's largest economy, and regulatory burden and public investment levels shape industrial output and corporate investment decisions across the region.

n3cf7c87ed3.headline: PSX witnesses bullish trend, gains 663 points
n3cf7c87ed3.summary: The 100-index of the Pakistan Stock Exchange rose 663.42 points, or 0.57 percent, to 116,199.59 on Monday, with 507.5 million shares traded.
n3cf7c87ed3.why: The Pakistan Stock Exchange's 100-index tracks the largest listed companies in Pakistan and is a key gauge of local equity performance.

nc1e189d879.headline: Energiekontor benefits from hopes for financial package
nc1e189d879.summary: Energiekontor shares rose strongly on Monday as prospects of billions in German climate-protection investment boosted the project developer.
nc1e189d879.why: Energiekontor is a German renewable energy project developer, so government climate spending directly affects its project pipeline.

n7b4173ac22.headline: Consumers loading up on booze as Trump threatens massive tariff on alcohol from EU
n7b4173ac22.summary: President Trump has threatened a 200% tariff on alcohol from the EU. A US wine and spirits retailer said consumers are stocking up ahead of the potential duty.
n7b4173ac22.why: US tariffs on EU goods affect transatlantic trade flows, pricing for importers and retailers, and EU exporters of wine and spirits.

n3fc0e9d15d.headline: Rupee gains 5 paisa against dollar
n3fc0e9d15d.summary: The rupee appreciated by 5 paisa against the dollar in interbank trading, closing at Rs280.16 against Rs280.21 the previous day. Open-market rates were Rs280.50 buying and Rs282.00 selling.
n3fc0e9d15d.why: The rupee's exchange rate affects Pakistan's import costs, inflation and the external debt burden, and the interbank rate is the official reference.

n69edf130ba.headline: IPO:  Stada wants to return to the stockmarket as soon as possible
n69edf130ba.summary: German pharmaceutical group Stada plans to launch its initial public offering on Wednesday, according to two sources close to the matter. The listing would be a major test for European equity markets.
n69edf130ba.why: Stada is a German generic pharmaceuticals group, and large IPOs signal investor appetite for European equities. Successful listings can reopen the capital markets pipeline.

n3e7d4655d2.headline: Emaar Properties sees record property sales in 2024
n3e7d4655d2.summary: Emaar Properties reported its highest ever sales, revenue and profit in 2024. Property sales rose 72% year on year to AED70 billion, lifting its backlog to AED110 billion.
n3e7d4655d2.why: Emaar is a Dubai-based developer behind major residential and commercial projects, and a key bellwether for the UAE property market. Its backlog indicates future revenue visibility.

n9e456e49a3.headline: Pakistan’s trade deficit declined to $24.11bn in FY24
n9e456e49a3.summary: Pakistan's trade deficit declined from $27.47 billion in FY23 to $24.11 billion in FY24, attributed to lower imports and higher exports, the commerce minister told parliament.
n9e456e49a3.why: The trade deficit measures the gap between Pakistan's imports and exports, a key indicator for its external financing needs and currency pressure.

n37f4373d27.headline: TSX futures dip; focus on upcoming Fed rate decision
n37f4373d27.summary: Futures tied to Canada's main stock index dipped on Monday, tracking Wall Street peers, as investors looked ahead to the Fed's rate decision later in the week.
n37f4373d27.why: The S&P/TSX Composite is Canada's main equity benchmark, heavily weighted toward banks, energy and mining.

n0caac27631.headline: Ne Zha 2 Overtakes Star Wars With Massive Box Office Milestone
n0caac27631.summary: Chinese animated film Ne Zha 2 overtakes Star Wars: The Force Awakens at worldwide box office, marking a significant entertainment industry achievement.
n0caac27631.why: Major box office milestones influence media and entertainment investments, especially in Asian markets.

ncf2f2548c6.headline: China's retail sales strengthen at the start of the year, industrial output tops expectations
ncf2f2548c6.summary: China’s economic data for the first two months of the year showed a modest pickup, with retail sales strengthening and industrial output surpassing expectations.
ncf2f2548c6.why: China's economic performance influences global supply chains and commodity demand, impacting markets worldwide.
